page.content:
Wolf raised in Asgard, bound until he kills Odin.

How Fenrir connects

  • Character: Loki — Loki is father of Fenrir.
  • Character: Tyr — Tyr lost his hand binding Fenrir.
  • Event: Ragnarok — Fenrir breaks free and swallows Odin at Ragnarok.

What is Fenrir?

Fenrir grows too large for the gods, bites off Tyr's hand, and waits bound on the islet. At Ragnarok he swallows Odin and is killed by Vidar.

Key threads lead to Loki, Tyr and Ragnarok.
